description: THIS IS A SOLE SOURCE SYNOPSIS. ACC-RSA has a sole source requirement for Cameo Enterprise Architecture-Enterprise Edition (Nodelock). This is a Sole Source with Cameo Enterprise Architecture-Enterprise Edition (Nodelock) IAW FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B). IAW FAR 16.505(b)(2)(i)(B) Dassault Systems Americas Corp., is the only source capable of fulfilling the Government's requirement for Cameo Enterprise Architecture-Enterprise Edition (Nodelock). This provides essential services required by the customer in a classified environment. No Solicitation documents exist at this time. This item utilizes North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code of 513210. IAW FAR 5.207(c)(16_(ii) all responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. This provides essential services required by the customer in a classified environment. ACC-RSA will not be responsible for any costs incurred by the interested parties in responding to this notice. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotes. Phone calls will not be accepted.
